selection.method: Full-batch softmax cross-entropy plus lambda/2 * ||W-W_original||^2; fixed encoder; 800 steps, lr=4; float64 optimizer, float32 saved heads.
selection.selection: Per-axis lowest development cross entropy, no evaluation/legacy67 selection; ties prefer stronger prior. Development construction families are disjoint.
selection.limitations: Tiny unapproved synthetic corpus, partial coverage, no original 477-item training corpus in repository. This is a feasibility/failure experiment, not a deployment recommendation.
